sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail who is in custody since 10.11.2022 in connection with FIR No.540/2022 registered at Police Station M.P.Nagar, District-Bhopal, for the offence punishable under Sections 420,511 and 120-B of IPC.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he took gold loan from the bank on the basis of forged gold ornaments.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has not committed any offence and was falsely implicated.
It is stated that while taking the loan, the gold ornaments are normally checked by the banks and, at that time, they were found proper.
Later on, somehow, the applicant was falsely implicated.
It is further stated that the applicant has no past criminal antecedents, he is in jail since for the last more than five months and charge sheet has already been filed.

sentences.text: Learned GA has vehemently opposed the bail application.
However, he fairly submits that there are no criminal antecedents registered against the present applicant.
Considering the aforesaid, without adverting to the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

I t is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
